parsed.text: Summary (origins and times retained): Panels p0 and p1 provide fallible 4×4 location distributions for red and blue at nodes n0–n3. Current (view=current): p0 shows uniform distributions at n0–n2 and a concentrated blue peak at (1,0) and red peak at (1,2) for n3. p1 current: n0–n1 and n3 are uniform; n2 splits peaks by quadrant: blue peaks on the top-right 2×2 cells and red peaks on the top-left 2×2 cells. Candidate command records (view=candidate) differ by command: many nodes remain uniform across commands; notable differences occur at node n2 in both panels. In p0 candidates k0–k2, n2’s blue peak is at (0,2) and red peak at (0,1) (single-cell peaks) while other nodes vary between uniform and concentrated. In p1 candidates, k0 keeps n2’s quadrant peaks, k1 concentrates blue at (0,2) and red at (0,1), and k2 is uniform at n2.
